name: Aphelion of Earth
description:
• Eclipses the R.E.D. armor. You instead can read curse books, sacrificing health to cast powerful eldritch spells which mark targets and **corrupt **your next punch. You can punch marked enemies from any range to siphon the mark and refund part of the sacrifice.
  • Sneak-right-click with a curse book to morph it into a cursed tome which can hold 5 curse books.
  • **Eclipse: **The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.
discoveredBy: TheJ_Team, Winzor, ElectricSparx, and Schwump on 06/07/25
